rows.reply: Dear Complainant, thank you for reaching out to us regarding the seven-year-old child allegedly locked in a room without food in Bekasi. Your ticket number is ATK-01, and our Special Protection: violence, sexual crimes and children in conflict with the law team handles this case with an expected first response within 2 hours. A supervisor has been alerted now. If anyone is in immediate danger, please call SAPA 129 (women and child protection hotline): 129, WhatsApp 08111-129-129, or Police emergency: 110. Next, a social worker will assess the complaint [1]. Please prepare your identity, the child's identity, and supporting information about the complaint [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)

Halo. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai kondisi rumah yang terendam rob dan anggota keluarga yang sakit di Sayung dengan nomor tiket ATK-02. Laporan Anda telah diteruskan ke tim Perlindungan Sosial dan Keamanan, dan seorang pengawas telah diberitahu sekarang karena ini adalah situasi darurat [1]. Anda akan mendapatkan tanggapan pertama dalam waktu 2 jam paling lama [1]. Karena ini melibatkan bahaya langsung, jika Anda memerlukan bantuan darurat segera, silakan hubungi Layanan Darurat Umum di 112 atau Polisi di 110. Selanjutnya, petugas akan segera melakukan kunjungan ke lokasi bencana untuk memeriksa kondisi dan kebutuhan bantuan [2]. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Salam hangat. Kami telah menerima laporan mengenai anak Bapak/Ibu yang mengalami perundungan oleh teman sekelasnya di Semarang sehingga menolak pergi ke sekolah, dengan nomor tiket ATK-03. Pengaduan ini ditangani oleh tim klaster pendidikan dan Anda akan mendapatkan tanggapan pertama dalam waktu 72 jam. Selanjutnya, petugas kami akan melakukan penilaian terhadap pengaduan Anda [1]. Mohon siapkan identitas pelapor, identitas anak seperti akta kelahiran atau kartu keluarga, serta informasi pendukung pengaduan [2]. Pengaduan ini berlandaskan pada Undang-Undang Nomor 35 Tahun 2014 tentang Perlindungan Anak. Jika anak membutuhkan bantuan mendesak, Anda dapat menghubungi SAPA 129 melalui nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129. Hormat kami, Unit Pengaduan, Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI).

Dear Parent, thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI) regarding the cyberbullying your 14-year-old son is experiencing on Instagram. Your complaint has been registered under ticket number ATK-04, and it is handled by our Special Protection team. Because the data is incomplete, an officer will contact you within 3 x 24 hours [1]. Please prepare your identity, the child's identity such as a birth certificate or family card, and any information supporting the complaint. If anyone is in immediate danger, please call SAPA 129 at 129 or WhatsApp 08111-129-129, Police emergency at 110, or General emergency at 112. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)

Halo, terima kasih telah menyampaikan laporan terkait bantuan PKH yang belum cair selama tiga bulan di Wonosalam. Laporan Anda telah kami terima dengan nomor tiket ATK-05 dan akan ditangani oleh Tim Perlindungan dan Jaminan Sosial dalam waktu 72 jam [1]. Petugas akan memeriksa status penerima dalam data, status penyaluran tahap berjalan, serta kondisi kartu KKS atau rekening bank Anda [1]. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Dear Resident, Thank you for contacting the Demak Regency Social Affairs Office regarding your BPNT food aid stopping in July. We have registered your report under ticket number ATK-06, which has been routed to our Social Protection & Security Division (linjamsos) team. An officer will check within 3 working days: the recipient's status in DTSEN, the payment status for the current round, and the status of the KKS card or bank account [1]. Please note that we cannot guarantee specific payment dates as requested for your landlord, but our team will review your status according to our standard procedures. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

flagged: Says the case is closed; only staff set the status
rows.reply: Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI) regarding your request for officer details and case status update. Your inquiry has been registered under ticket number ATK-07 and is handled by our complaints unit, and you can expect a first response within 336 hours. Next, our desk team will check if this is a child protection case. A case is closed with the complainant's agreement, or unilaterally if the complainant cannot be reached 3 times within 3 weeks [2]. If you need immediate assistance, you can contact SAPA 129 (women and child protection hotline): 129 or WhatsApp 08111-129-129, Police emergency: 110, or General emergency: 112. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)

Terima kasih telah menghubungi Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI). Pesan Anda telah kami terima dengan nomor tiket ATK-08 dan saat ini sedang ditangani oleh tim Pengaduan (front desk and assessment) kami, dengan perkiraan tanggapan pertama dalam waktu 336 jam. Mohon maaf, pesan Anda sebelumnya belum memuat informasi atau aduan terkait perlindungan anak, sehingga kami perlu menanyakan: apa bentuk pelanggaran hak anak yang ingin Anda laporkan, dan siapa pihak yang terlibat dalam kejadian tersebut? Dokumen yang perlu Anda siapkan meliputi identitas pelapor, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung pengaduan [1], [2]. Jika anak berada dalam situasi darurat, silakan hubungi SAPA 129 melalui nomor 129 atau WhatsApp 08111-129-129, serta Kepolisian di 110. Hormat kami, Unit Pengaduan, Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI).

Dear Complainant, we have received your report regarding the price increase of items at your child's school canteen. Your ticket number is ATK-09, and it has been assigned to our Education team for review. You can expect a first response within 336 hours. Next, your complaint will be checked to determine if it concerns child protection [3]. If you wish to make an in-person complaint, please prepare your identity, the child's identity, and supporting information about the complaint [2]. If you need immediate assistance, you can contact SAPA 129 at 129 or WhatsApp 08111-129-129, Police emergency at 110, or General emergency at 112. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)

Dear resident, we acknowledge that the village of Bedono has been without clean water for three days following a tidal flood, affecting vulnerable populations including babies and elderly residents. Your ticket number is ATK-10. This has been routed to the Disaster victim protection (Social Protection & Security Division) team, and you will receive a first response within 24 hours. Emergency complaints go straight to the supervisor and get a response within 2 hours at most [1]. Next, a caseworker will conduct a site visit to identify needs and the type of aid [1]. For general emergencies, you can also contact BPBD Demak (regional disaster management agency) or General emergency: 112. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Terima kasih atas laporan Anda mengenai dugaan anak berusia sekitar 10 tahun yang dipaksa mengemis di Simpang Lima. Laporan Anda telah kami terima dengan nomor tiket ATK-11 dan ditangani oleh tim pengaduan eksploitasi. Karena laporan ini bersifat darurat dengan dugaan bahaya langsung, seorang supervisor telah diberitahu sekarang. Jika anak berada dalam bahaya sekarang, mohon segera hubungi polisi di nomor 110 atau SAPA 129 (WhatsApp 08111-129-129) [3]. Tim kami akan memberikan tanggapan pertama dalam waktu 2 jam. Selanjutnya, seorang pekerja sosial akan melakukan asesmen terhadap pengaduan ini dan supervisor akan merujuk kasus ke penyedia layanan terkait jika diperlukan [1]. Mohon persiapkan identitas pelapor, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung lainnya [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)

Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI) regarding your request to verify the status of your submission and view recent complaints, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-12. Our Complaints team is reviewing your message and will provide a first response within 336 hours. Please note that for privacy and data protection reasons, we cannot share details or names of other complainants. Next, the front desk checks the documents, identifies whether the case concerns child protection, and enters the complaint form into the database [1]. If you need immediate assistance, you can contact SAPA 129 (women and child protection hotline) at 129 or via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)

Salam hangat. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai kendala kartu KIS lansia yang tidak aktif untuk wilayah Mijen dengan nomor tiket ATK-13. Tim SLRT kami akan segera menindaklanjuti laporan Anda dan memberikan tanggapan pertama dalam waktu 72 jam. Selanjutnya, tim kami akan mencatat data keluhan dalam sistem SLRT dan melaporkannya kepada Sub Koordinator, Kepala Bidang, serta Kepala Dinas [1]. Untuk persiapan, mohon Anda dapat menyiapkan fotokopi Kartu Tanda Penduduk (KTP) dan Kartu Keluarga (KK). Demikian informasi yang dapat kami sampaikan. Salam hangat, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Dear Complainant, we acknowledge receipt of your report regarding your six-year-old niece. Your ticket number is ATK-14. This matter has been routed to our Special Protection team, and a supervisor has been alerted now. You will receive a first response within 2 hours. If anyone is in immediate danger, please call SAPA 129 (women and child protection hotline): 129 · WhatsApp 08111-129-129, Police emergency: 110, or General emergency: 112. Next, a social worker will conduct an assessment of the complaint, followed by a referral to a service provider such as SAPA 129, UPTD PPA, Dinas Sosial, or the police [1]. Please prepare the complainant's identity, the child's identity, and supporting information about the complaint [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI)
